purpose: Establish a non-floor AppWorld backbone using the user-approved free local API route before testing private-experience capability differentiation.
supersede_reason: User selected API inference to remove self-hosted GPU/runtime confounds; the prior Qwen3-14B self-hosted gate was not run.

inference.credential_policy: No API secret is stored in the project; the local router resolves its upstream credential from the user's existing environment.
inference.router_smoke: HTTP 200 on upstream /v1/responses; observed model qwen3.8-max and output API_OK.
inference.adapter_smoke: Before any benchmark run, AppWorld's pinned OpenAI SDK returned a standard Response object through 8318 with model qwen3.8-max and output SDK_PROXY_OK. The adapter only aggregates upstream SSE response.completed into JSON.

decision_rule: Run all three siblings. >=2/3 establishes a usable non-floor development regime. <=1/3 triggers a different strong API backbone before any experience-factorial target run. These scores are development feasibility only.
